sections.title: Example 1: Basic Dbscan Clustering
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 1: Basic DBSCAN Clustering")
print("-" * 60)

# Generate synthetic data with clear clusters and some noise
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 300
n_features = 2

# Create clusters with some noise
X, true_labels = make_blobs(
    n_samples=n_samples,
    n_features=n_features,
    centers=3,
    cluster_std=0.8,
    random_state=42,
)

# Add some noise points
noise_points = np.random.uniform(-5, 5, (20, n_features))
X = np.vstack([X, noise_points])
true_labels = np.concatenate([true_labels, [-1] * 20])  # -1 for noise

print(f"Dataset shape: {X.shape}")
print(f"Number of true clusters: {len(np.unique(true_labels[true_labels != -1]))}")

# Basic DBSCAN clustering
dbscan_basic = DBSCAN(eps=0.5, min_samples=5, metric="euclidean")

dbscan_basic.fit(X)
labels = dbscan_basic.labels_

print(f"\nDBSCAN Results:")
print(f"Number of clusters: {len(np.unique(labels[labels != -1]))}")
print(f"Cluster labels: {np.unique(labels)}")
print(f"Number of noise points: {np.sum(labels == -1)}")
print(f"Noise percentage: {(np.sum(labels == -1) / len(labels)) * 100:.1f}%")

# Evaluation metrics (excluding noise points)
non_noise_mask = labels != -1
if len(np.unique(labels[non_noise_mask])) > 1:
    silhouette_avg = silhouette_score(X[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask])
    calinski_avg = calinski_harabasz_score(X[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask])
    davies_avg = davies_bouldin_score(X[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask])
else:
    silhouette_avg = calinski_avg = davies_avg = 0

print(f"\nEvaluation Metrics (excluding noise):")
print(f"Silhouette Score: {silhouette_avg:.4f}")
print(f"Calinski-Harabasz Index: {calinski_avg:.4f}")
print(f"Davies-Bouldin Index: {davies_avg:.4f}")

# Cluster analysis
unique_labels = np.unique(labels)
print(f"\nCluster Analysis:")
for label in unique_labels:
    if label == -1:
        cluster_size = np.sum(labels == label)
        cluster_percentage = (cluster_size / len(labels)) * 100
        print(f"Noise: {cluster_size} points ({cluster_percentage:.1f}%)")
    else:
        cluster_size = np.sum(labels == label)
        cluster_percentage = (cluster_size / len(labels)) * 100
        print(f"Cluster {label}: {cluster_size} points ({cluster_percentage:.1f}%)")

joblib.dump(dbscan_basic, "models/dbscan_example1_basic.pkl")
print("Basic DBSCAN model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 2: K-Distance Method for Eps Selection
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 2: K-Distance Method for Eps Selection")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate data for eps selection
np.random.seed(42)
X_eps = make_blobs(n_samples=200, n_features=2, centers=3, random_state=42)[0]

print(f"Eps selection dataset shape: {X_eps.shape}")

# Test different min_samples values
min_samples_values = [3, 5, 7, 10]
results_eps = {}

print("K-Distance Analysis for Different MinPts:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'MinPts':<8s} {'Suggested Eps':<15s} {'Elbow Point':<15s}")
print("-" * 60)

for min_samples in min_samples_values:
    # Find k-distance
    neighbors = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=min_samples)
    neighbors_fit = neighbors.fit(X_eps)
    distances, indices = neighbors_fit.kneighbors(X_eps)
    distances = np.sort(distances[:, -1])

    # Find elbow point (simplified method)
    # In practice, you would use more sophisticated methods
    elbow_idx = int(len(distances) * 0.1)  # 10th percentile as approximation
    suggested_eps = distances[elbow_idx]

    results_eps[min_samples] = {
        "distances": distances,
        "suggested_eps": suggested_eps,
        "elbow_idx": elbow_idx,
    }

    print(f"{min_samples:<8d} {suggested_eps:<15.4f} {elbow_idx:<15d}")

# Test DBSCAN with different eps values
eps_values = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0]
min_samples = 5

print(f"\nDBSCAN Performance with Different Eps Values:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Eps':<8s} {'Clusters':<10s} {'Noise %':<10s} {'Silhouette':<12s}")
print("-" * 60)

for eps in eps_values:
    dbscan = DBSCAN(eps=eps, min_samples=min_samples)
    dbscan.fit(X_eps)
    labels = dbscan.labels_

    n_clusters = len(np.unique(labels[labels != -1]))
    noise_percentage = (np.sum(labels == -1) / len(labels)) * 100

    # Calculate silhouette score
    non_noise_mask = labels != -1
    if len(np.unique(labels[non_noise_mask])) > 1:
        silhouette = silhouette_score(X_eps[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask])
    else:
        silhouette = 0

    print(
        f"{eps:<8.1f} {n_clusters:<10d} {noise_percentage:<10.1f} {silhouette:<12.4f}"
    )

best_eps = 0.5  # Based on the results above
print(f"\nSuggested eps value: {best_eps}")

joblib.dump(results_eps, "models/dbscan_example2_eps_analysis.pkl")
print("Eps analysis results saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 3: Dbscan with Different Distance Metrics
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 3: DBSCAN with Different Distance Metrics")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate data for distance metric comparison
np.random.seed(42)
X_metric = make_blobs(n_samples=250, n_features=2, centers=4, random_state=42)[0]

print(f"Distance metric dataset shape: {X_metric.shape}")

# Test different distance metrics
distance_metrics = ["euclidean", "manhattan", "cosine"]
results_metrics = {}

print("DBSCAN Performance with Different Distance Metrics:")
print("-" * 70)
print(
    f"{'Metric':<12s} {'Clusters':<10s} {'Noise %':<10s} {'Silhouette':<12s} {'Calinski':<12s}"
)
print("-" * 70)

for metric in distance_metrics:
    dbscan = DBSCAN(eps=0.5, min_samples=5, metric=metric)
    dbscan.fit(X_metric)
    labels = dbscan.labels_

    n_clusters = len(np.unique(labels[labels != -1]))
    noise_percentage = (np.sum(labels == -1) / len(labels)) * 100

    # Calculate metrics
    non_noise_mask = labels != -1
    if len(np.unique(labels[non_noise_mask])) > 1:
        silhouette = silhouette_score(X_metric[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask])
        calinski = calinski_harabasz_score(
            X_metric[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask]
        )
    else:
        silhouette = calinski = 0

    results_metrics[metric] = {
        "n_clusters": n_clusters,
        "noise_percentage": noise_percentage,
        "silhouette": silhouette,
        "calinski": calinski,
        "model": dbscan,
    }

    print(
        f"{metric:<12s} {n_clusters:<10d} {noise_percentage:<10.1f} {silhouette:<12.4f} {calinski:<12.4f}"
    )

best_metric = max(
    results_metrics.keys(), key=lambda x: results_metrics[x]["silhouette"]
)
print(f"\nBest metric (highest silhouette): {best_metric}")

joblib.dump(
    results_metrics[best_metric]["model"], "models/dbscan_example3_best_metric.pkl"
)
print(f"Best model ({best_metric}) saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 4: Dbscan with Feature Scaling
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 4: DBSCAN with Feature Scaling")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate data with different scales
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 300

# Create features with different scales
feature1 = np.random.normal(0, 1, n_samples)  # Scale ~1
feature2 = np.random.normal(0, 100, n_samples)  # Scale ~100
feature3 = np.random.normal(0, 0.01, n_samples)  # Scale ~0.01

X_unscaled = np.column_stack([feature1, feature2, feature3])

# Add some clustering structure
X_unscaled[:100, 0] += 5
X_unscaled[100:200, 1] += 200
X_unscaled[200:300, 2] += 0.05

print("Feature scales before scaling:")
print(
    f"Feature 1: mean={X_unscaled[:, 0].mean():.4f}, std={X_unscaled[:, 0].std():.4f}"
)
print(
    f"Feature 2: mean={X_unscaled[:, 1].mean():.4f}, std={X_unscaled[:, 1].std():.4f}"
)
print(
    f"Feature 3: mean={X_unscaled[:, 2].mean():.4f}, std={X_unscaled[:, 2].std():.4f}"
)

# DBSCAN without scaling
dbscan_unscaled = DBSCAN(eps=0.5, min_samples=5)
dbscan_unscaled.fit(X_unscaled)
labels_unscaled = dbscan_unscaled.labels_

# DBSCAN with scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_unscaled)

dbscan_scaled = DBSCAN(eps=0.5, min_samples=5)
dbscan_scaled.fit(X_scaled)
labels_scaled = dbscan_scaled.labels_

print(f"\nFeature scales after scaling:")
print(f"Feature 1: mean={X_scaled[:, 0].mean():.4f}, std={X_scaled[:, 0].std():.4f}")
print(f"Feature 2: mean={X_scaled[:, 1].mean():.4f}, std={X_scaled[:, 1].std():.4f}")
print(f"Feature 3: mean={X_scaled[:, 2].mean():.4f}, std={X_scaled[:, 2].std():.4f}")

# Compare results
print(f"\nComparison of Results:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Method':<15s} {'Clusters':<10s} {'Noise %':<10s} {'Silhouette':<12s}")
print("-" * 60)

n_clusters_unscaled = len(np.unique(labels_unscaled[labels_unscaled != -1]))
noise_percentage_unscaled = (np.sum(labels_unscaled == -1) / len(labels_unscaled)) * 100
non_noise_mask_unscaled = labels_unscaled != -1
if len(np.unique(labels_unscaled[non_noise_mask_unscaled])) > 1:
    silhouette_unscaled = silhouette_score(
        X_unscaled[non_noise_mask_unscaled], labels_unscaled[non_noise_mask_unscaled]
    )
else:
    silhouette_unscaled = 0

print(
    f"{'Unscaled':<15s} {n_clusters_unscaled:<10d} {noise_percentage_unscaled:<10.1f} {silhouette_unscaled:<12.4f}"
)

n_clusters_scaled = len(np.unique(labels_scaled[labels_scaled != -1]))
noise_percentage_scaled = (np.sum(labels_scaled == -1) / len(labels_scaled)) * 100
non_noise_mask_scaled = labels_scaled != -1
if len(np.unique(labels_scaled[non_noise_mask_scaled])) > 1:
    silhouette_scaled = silhouette_score(
        X_scaled[non_noise_mask_scaled], labels_scaled[non_noise_mask_scaled]
    )
else:
    silhouette_scaled = 0

print(
    f"{'Scaled':<15s} {n_clusters_scaled:<10d} {noise_percentage_scaled:<10.1f} {silhouette_scaled:<12.4f}"
)

joblib.dump(dbscan_scaled, "models/dbscan_example4_scaled.pkl")
print("Scaled DBSCAN model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 5: Dbscan on Complex Shapes
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 5: DBSCAN on Complex Shapes")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate complex shapes
np.random.seed(42)

# Dataset 1: Moons
X_moons, _ = make_moons(n_samples=200, noise=0.1, random_state=42)

# Dataset 2: Circles
X_circles, _ = make_circles(n_samples=200, noise=0.1, factor=0.5, random_state=42)

# Dataset 3: Blobs with noise
X_blobs = make_blobs(n_samples=300, centers=3, cluster_std=1.0, random_state=42)[0]
noise_points = np.random.uniform(-5, 5, (30, 2))
X_blobs = np.vstack([X_blobs, noise_points])

datasets = {"Moons": X_moons, "Circles": X_circles, "Blobs with Noise": X_blobs}

print("DBSCAN Performance on Complex Shapes:")
print("-" * 70)
print(
    f"{'Dataset':<18s} {'Eps':<6s} {'Clusters':<10s} {'Noise %':<10s} {'Silhouette':<12s}"
)
print("-" * 70)

results_shapes = {}

for name, X_data in datasets.items():
    # Find optimal eps using k-distance
    neighbors = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=5)
    neighbors_fit = neighbors.fit(X_data)
    distances, indices = neighbors_fit.kneighbors(X_data)
    distances = np.sort(distances[:, -1])
    suggested_eps = distances[int(len(distances) * 0.1)]

    # Test DBSCAN
    dbscan = DBSCAN(eps=suggested_eps, min_samples=5)
    dbscan.fit(X_data)
    labels = dbscan.labels_

    n_clusters = len(np.unique(labels[labels != -1]))
    noise_percentage = (np.sum(labels == -1) / len(labels)) * 100

    # Calculate silhouette score
    non_noise_mask = labels != -1
    if len(np.unique(labels[non_noise_mask])) > 1:
        silhouette = silhouette_score(X_data[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask])
    else:
        silhouette = 0

    results_shapes[name] = {
        "eps": suggested_eps,
        "n_clusters": n_clusters,
        "noise_percentage": noise_percentage,
        "silhouette": silhouette,
        "model": dbscan,
    }

    print(
        f"{name:<18s} {suggested_eps:<6.3f} {n_clusters:<10d} {noise_percentage:<10.1f} {silhouette:<12.4f}"
    )

print(f"\nKey Insights:")
print("- DBSCAN can handle non-spherical clusters")
print("- Parameter selection is crucial for performance")
print("- Noise handling varies with dataset complexity")

joblib.dump(results_shapes, "models/dbscan_example5_complex_shapes.pkl")
print("Complex shapes analysis saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 6: Dbscan Parameter Sensitivity
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 6: DBSCAN Parameter Sensitivity")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate data for parameter sensitivity analysis
np.random.seed(42)
X_sensitivity = make_blobs(n_samples=400, n_features=2, centers=4, random_state=42)[0]

print(f"Parameter sensitivity dataset shape: {X_sensitivity.shape}")

# Test different eps and min_samples combinations
eps_values = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0]
min_samples_values = [3, 5, 7, 10]

results_sensitivity = {}

print("DBSCAN Parameter Sensitivity Analysis:")
print("-" * 70)
print(
    f"{'Eps':<6s} {'MinPts':<8s} {'Clusters':<10s} {'Noise %':<10s} {'Silhouette':<12s}"
)
print("-" * 70)

for eps in eps_values:
    results_sensitivity[eps] = {}
    for min_samples in min_samples_values:
        dbscan = DBSCAN(eps=eps, min_samples=min_samples)
        dbscan.fit(X_sensitivity)
        labels = dbscan.labels_

        n_clusters = len(np.unique(labels[labels != -1]))
        noise_percentage = (np.sum(labels == -1) / len(labels)) * 100

        # Calculate silhouette score
        non_noise_mask = labels != -1
        if len(np.unique(labels[non_noise_mask])) > 1:
            silhouette = silhouette_score(
                X_sensitivity[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask]
            )
        else:
            silhouette = 0

        results_sensitivity[eps][min_samples] = {
            "n_clusters": n_clusters,
            "noise_percentage": noise_percentage,
            "silhouette": silhouette,
            "model": dbscan,
        }

        print(
            f"{eps:<6.1f} {min_samples:<8d} {n_clusters:<10d} {noise_percentage:<10.1f} {silhouette:<12.4f}"
        )

# Find best parameters
best_silhouette = 0
best_params = None

for eps in eps_values:
    for min_samples in min_samples_values:
        silhouette = results_sensitivity[eps][min_samples]["silhouette"]
        if silhouette > best_silhouette:
            best_silhouette = silhouette
            best_params = (eps, min_samples)

best_eps, best_min_samples = best_params
print(
    f"\nBest parameters (highest silhouette): eps={best_eps}, min_samples={best_min_samples}"
)

joblib.dump(results_sensitivity, "models/dbscan_example6_parameter_sensitivity.pkl")
print("Parameter sensitivity analysis saved to: models/")
```

sections.body:

```python
print("\n\nExample 7: Comprehensive DBSCAN Analysis")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate comprehensive dataset
np.random.seed(42)
X_comprehensive = make_blobs(
    n_samples=600, n_features=3, centers=5, cluster_std=1.2, random_state=42
)[0]

# Add noise
noise_points = np.random.uniform(-8, 8, (50, 3))
X_comprehensive = np.vstack([X_comprehensive, noise_points])

print(f"Comprehensive dataset shape: {X_comprehensive.shape}")

# Scale the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_comprehensive_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_comprehensive)

# Find optimal parameters using k-distance
neighbors = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=5)
neighbors_fit = neighbors.fit(X_comprehensive_scaled)
distances, indices = neighbors_fit.kneighbors(X_comprehensive_scaled)
distances = np.sort(distances[:, -1])
suggested_eps = distances[int(len(distances) * 0.1)]

print(f"Suggested eps from k-distance: {suggested_eps:.4f}")

# Test different parameter combinations
eps_values = [
    suggested_eps * 0.5,
    suggested_eps,
    suggested_eps * 1.5,
    suggested_eps * 2.0,
]
min_samples_values = [3, 5, 7, 10]
results_comprehensive = {}

print("Comprehensive DBSCAN Analysis:")
print("-" * 70)
print(
    f"{'Eps':<8s} {'MinPts':<8s} {'Clusters':<10s} {'Noise %':<10s} {'Silhouette':<12s} {'Calinski':<12s}"
)
print("-" * 70)

for eps in eps_values:
    results_comprehensive[eps] = {}
    for min_samples in min_samples_values:
        dbscan = DBSCAN(eps=eps, min_samples=min_samples)
        dbscan.fit(X_comprehensive_scaled)
        labels = dbscan.labels_

        n_clusters = len(np.unique(labels[labels != -1]))
        noise_percentage = (np.sum(labels == -1) / len(labels)) * 100

        # Calculate metrics
        non_noise_mask = labels != -1
        if len(np.unique(labels[non_noise_mask])) > 1:
            silhouette = silhouette_score(
                X_comprehensive_scaled[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask]
            )
            calinski = calinski_harabasz_score(
                X_comprehensive_scaled[non_noise_mask], labels[non_noise_mask]
            )
        else:
            silhouette = calinski = 0

        results_comprehensive[eps][min_samples] = {
            "n_clusters": n_clusters,
            "noise_percentage": noise_percentage,
            "silhouette": silhouette,
            "calinski": calinski,
            "model": dbscan,
        }

        print(
            f"{eps:<8.3f} {min_samples:<8d} {n_clusters:<10d} {noise_percentage:<10.1f} {silhouette:<12.4f} {calinski:<12.4f}"
        )

# Find best configuration
best_silhouette = 0
best_config = None

for eps in eps_values:
    for min_samples in min_samples_values:
        silhouette = results_comprehensive[eps][min_samples]["silhouette"]
        if silhouette > best_silhouette:
            best_silhouette = silhouette
            best_config = (eps, min_samples)

best_eps, best_min_samples = best_config
best_model = results_comprehensive[best_eps][best_min_samples]["model"]

print(f"\nBest Configuration:")
print(f"Eps: {best_eps:.4f}")
print(f"MinPts: {best_min_samples}")
print(f"Silhouette Score: {best_silhouette:.4f}")

# Final model analysis
final_labels = best_model.labels_
unique_labels = np.unique(final_labels)

print(f"\nFinal Model Analysis:")
print(f"Number of clusters: {len(unique_labels[unique_labels != -1])}")
print(f"Number of noise points: {np.sum(final_labels == -1)}")
print(
    f"Noise percentage: {(np.sum(final_labels == -1) / len(final_labels)) * 100:.1f}%"
)

# Cluster analysis
print(f"\nCluster Distribution:")
for label in unique_labels:
    if label == -1:
        cluster_size = np.sum(final_labels == label)
        cluster_percentage = (cluster_size / len(final_labels)) * 100
        print(f"Noise: {cluster_size} points ({cluster_percentage:.1f}%)")
    else:
        cluster_size = np.sum(final_labels == label)
        cluster_percentage = (cluster_size / len(final_labels)) * 100
        print(f"Cluster {label}: {cluster_size} points ({cluster_percentage:.1f}%)")

joblib.dump(best_model, "models/dbscan_example7_comprehensive.pkl")
print("Comprehensive DBSCAN model saved to: models/")

# Summary
```
